claims.assertion: Yazhi described the pyramids as zero-point generators with wireless power and consciousness-enhancing portal functions.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She attributed these functions to their electromagnetic design and internal systems.

claims.assertion: Athena said pyramid builders used a Great Gallery crane and spiral ramp; antigravity partly lightened stones, while liquid rock molded some blocks.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She doubted central cranes lifted the largest blocks.

claims.assertion: Anéeka said the Sphinx predates the pyramids and its form symbolized Egypt's two kingdoms and the yearly Virgo-to-Leo cycle.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She described it as a building, not a realistic statue.
